name: exporter-android
description: Supernova Android token and style exporter

scripts.export:mv: npm run build && SN_LOCAL=true npx supernova run-local-exporter --apiKey="$SN_API_KEY" --designSystemId="$SN_DESIGN_SYSTEM_ID" --brandId="$SN_BRAND_MINDVALLEY" --exporterDir="." --outputDir=".build/output-mv" --allowOverridingOutput
scripts.export:eve: npm run build && SN_LOCAL=true npx supernova run-local-exporter --apiKey="$SN_API_KEY" --designSystemId="$SN_DESIGN_SYSTEM_ID" --brandId="$SN_BRAND_EVE" --exporterDir="." --outputDir=".build/output-eve" --allowOverridingOutput
